title: Figure source data and manuscript number registry
notes: Per-panel figure source data plus the manuscript number registry, analysis-to-claim matrix, exclusions/denominator table, supplementary-table index and software manifest. Built 2026-09-22 as fig-all-20260922-c on the rescored lgv-AA-*-rescore-20260913 score and the re-run, now citable, Module 09 stage 17/18 tables. The run carries a code/ snapshot of _h/ and config/ and records git_dirty = false, so the code that produced it is recoverable from the run itself; earlier builds did not, which is why fig-all-20260920 and fig-all-20260922{,-a,-b} are superseded (see DEPRECATED_RUNS.tsv). The registry is derived from what the figure builders actually rendered, so it is a record rather than a second list. Every panel carries its source run ID, table, script and row filter (AGENTS.md 7.11). Accepted 2026-09-22 (ACCEPTED_MANUSCRIPT_OUTPUTS); see the Accepted runs table in 11_integrated_manuscript_outputs/README.md.
